newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - N.J. Educational Authority.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE - NEW ISSUE
New Jersey Educational Facilities Authority
Revenue Bonds, Ramapo College of New Jersey Issue, Series
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Executive Director of the New Jersey Educational Facilities Authority (the
Authority'') will receive SEALED BIDS with respect to the Authority's $7,330,000 aggregate principal amount of New Jersey Educational Facilities Authority Revenue Bonds,
Ramapo College of New Jersey Issue, Series 1997 A (the Bonds'') at the Authority's office located at 101 College Road East, Princeton, New Jersey 08648 until 11:00 a.m., prevailing time, on
Wednesday, April 16, 1997
(the Bid Date''), and, then and there, such bids will be publicly opened and announced by the Authority for the purchase of all (but not less than all) of the Bonds.
The Bonds will mature, subject to the right of prior redemption as described hereinafter, on each July 1

beginning July 1, 2003 through and including July 1, 2007. Unless all Bids applicable to the Bonds are rejected, such Bonds will be awarded at or prior to 5:00 p.m., prevailing time, on the Bid Date at the Authority's office to the bidder offering such interest rate or rates and purchase prices which will produce the lowest net effective interest rate to the Authority over the life of the Bonds. Such interest rate shall be determined on a true'' or
Canadian'' interest cost (TIC) basis.

cost shall be determined for each bid by doubling the semi- annual interest rate, compounded semiannually, necessary to discount the debt service payments from the payment dates to April 1, 1997 and the price bid, such price bid excluding interest accrued to the date of delivery.
The Bonds are subject to prior optional redemption on or after July 1, 2002. The Bonds may be subject to
extraordinary redemption prior to maturity as more fully described in the Notice of Sale.

The Bonds are offered when, as, and if issued and received by the successful bidder, subject to the approval of legality of LeBoeuf, Lamb, Greene & MacRae, L.L.P., Newark, New Jersey, Bond Counsel to the Authority. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and the Official Notice of Sale and the Official Bid Form may be obtained from the Authority (telephone: 609-987-0880; facsimile: 609-987-0850) or from the Authority's Financial Advisor, A.H. Williams & Co., Inc., 392 Springfield Avenue, Summit, New Jersey 07901 (telephone: 908-522-8818; facsimile: 908-522-1599).
Dated: April 10, 1997
Rafael Perez
Executive Director
New Jersey Educational Facilities Authority
(From The Bond Buyer)
